checks.detail: Current contract is same complete ScanRefer model strictly >59.1%/>50.1% (5620/4764 of9508) plus three actually effective modules, then independent Sr3D/Nr3D training from corresponding author weights. Seed2027 only; no multiseed or current Nr/Sr launch.

Current control/keep specs differ only root and reference_keep_weight0/1. Both execute the new loss calculation; only its total-loss multiplier differs. Original native + G correction + edge/7 + extra_geometry_weight*extra is preserved.

Actual loss prefix order is proposal_, last_, then0head_ through4head_; matches[1] is native final-layer matching. Reference keep uses matched_targets within box_label_mask-filtered GT. Root remains filtered index0 under the explicit native contract.

Own Query and native-alpha fused Masks must each have point-member IoU>.5 against root. ALL matched queries are removed, including other-GT matches. New keep eligibility has no final-Box IoU cutoff. The old separate extra-geometry <=.5 condition remains unchanged.

Detached/clamped reference IoU is computed under no_grad; squared positive part(refIoU-finalIoU) is averaged once over each expression union, then divided by actual B. Selection is stopped-gradient. Only456102 geometry parameters/10 states are trainable; parent/Mask/text/native heads and zero-output R remain frozen. M0 explicitly checks outside-union direct output gradients, exact initial zero loss, and records new output-gradient norm.

Mask reference is derived from same-forward predicted own/fused Mask and current raw point members, with no GT input. Valid extent/native-prior rule is unchanged and the clamp1e-6 matches final decode. It reconstructs official PV+original G, original module construction order/frozen R, and loads all10 retained geometry tensors. Selected payload is step0 fused reference with empty Adam. M0 serializes geometry and Adam in memory, reads map_location=cpu, strictly reloads complete state, and compares model and all optimizer keys/moments/steps/groups. New loss is called only in training step. Inference stays unique last/bbs, all256 candidates and same selected Query Box/Mask. Formal initial/end outputs include9508 native metrics, per-row coarse/reference/final boxes, same-query Mask, and all256 arrays;6887 holdout initial/end evaluation is preserved. qualifications: This is a source-only, same-family provisional review. Backend identity and current runtime are not attested.
No current M0 update, loss/gradient measurement, CUDA success, trained weight, accuracy gain, or new CPU model execution is claimed.
Prior retained-state CPU and terminal acceptance receipts were reused within their original limits. No full terminal re-audit, raw-Mask reconstruction or thousands-row recount was performed.
Current5598/4848 is the retained zero-update architecture; prior continued-training5593/4832 is below its own start. The training mechanism and three-module claim remain unproven.

Formal training launch, formal capacity check using actual M0 serialization, terminal analysis/selection, selected-model restore and authorized retention are later stages. No concrete new formal launcher or selection/cleanup automation was included in this M0 source scope; none is approved by this report.
Module holdout is not unseen-scene generalization because official pretraining saw its scenes. Single-seed repeatedly used ScanRefer development evidence remains qualified.

Before formal launch, actual source/config identities remain unchanged, M0 is terminal and accepted, and result-space budget follows the experiment plan.

For any final candidate claim, use the same checkpoint for both thresholds and report against both current same-budget control and actual own initial metrics; do not infer module effectiveness from source approval.
